description: Defines the SparseControl class which manages sparse I/O operations for disk cache entries, including initialization, range queries, and child entry management.

classes.name: SparseControl
classes.description: Manages sparse disk cache operations, including initialization, I/O, range queries, and child entry management.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the sparse control for the current entry, updating disk info if necessary.

methods.name: CouldBeSparse
methods.description: Quickly tests if the entry could be sparse without disk I/O.

methods.name: StartIO
methods.description: Performs a sparse read or write operation asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAvailableRange
methods.description: Implements range query for sparse data.

methods.name: ReadyToUse
methods.description: Checks if the entry is ready for new I/O operations.

methods.name: DeleteChildren
methods.description: Deletes child entries of the given entry.
